tags.name: Cave dive site
tags.qa_note: Locally known as 'Galapita Gala' cave. Coordinates are ~150m from 'Gala pita gala dive site' in this dataset; the two entries very likely describe the same real-world boulder/cave complex (or immediately adjacent parts of it), flagged here as a probable near-duplicate rather than merged. Entry type corrected from shore to boat (10-15 min boat ride from Unawatuna dive centers per sources). Fabricated claims of glassfish, shrimp, moray eels, scorpionfish, turtles, and strong tidal cave-mouth currents removed. Re-audited 2026-10-02: only 2 fetched site-specific sources (unawatunadive.com, diveinsrilanka.com/sundivingsrilanka.com = one operator); TripAdvisor page returned 403 and could not be confirmed, so validated downgraded from true (below 3-domain bar). Probable near-duplicate pair retained.

tags.name: Carreg dive site
tags.qa_note: Re-audited 2026-07-03: no shipwreck database, dive-shop wreck listing, maritime archive, or Wikipedia entry names a wreck called 'Carreg' anywhere off Sri Lanka despite extensive search. Coordinates place this near Negombo, not Hikkaduwa as the prior markdown claimed (also corrected). Vessel name, build date, tonnage, and sinking cause are all unverified and were removed from the markdown; only the OSM historic=wreck/seamark:type=wreck tagging supports a wreck-like feature existing here at all. Downgraded from a prior 'validated: true' that was sourced only to the generic tag 'perplexity'. 2026-10-02: re-searched; still no wreck named Carreg found. Negombo area has charted wrecks (nsd.ccf.gov.lk) under other names; identity unresolved.

tags.name: Goddamahagale dive site
tags.qa_note: Re-audited 2026-07-03: coordinates are ~7km offshore WNW of Negombo (confirmed correct framing; a prior draft's 'near Kalutara/Beruwala/Bentota' correction was itself wrong and has been rejected). Name closely resembles 'Goda Maha Gala', named in Negombo operator site rosters, and a third-party database lists a 'Maha Gala' ~7.6km away -- plausibly related but not confirmed as the same site. Entry type corrected from shore to boat (Negombo-area sites are consistently boat dives several km offshore). Fabricated claims of hard corals, sea fans, lionfish, scorpionfish, wrasse, reliable turtles, and reef octopus removed. Downgraded from a prior 'validated: true' sourced only to the generic tag 'perplexity'. 2026-10-02: negombodivingcentre.com lists 'Goda Maha Gala' 6-7 km away, 12-15m (srilankatravelpages.com repeats it); name match to this node still unconfirmed, only 2 domains, not validated.

tags.name: Unuwatuna Coral Reef
tags.qa_note: Re-audited 2026-07-03: no dive-shop or forum source names this exact reef polygon; only bay-level (Unawatuna Bay generally) sourcing was found (thesrilankanguideline.com, sundivingsrilanka.com, pearldiverslk.com), which does not meet the site-specific 3-source bar, so validated was downgraded from a prior true (originally sourced only to the generic tag 'web_research'). The 'known_wrecks: SS Rangoon' tag previously on this entry was removed as incorrect -- SS Rangoon rests at 30-32m near the mouth of Galle Harbour, roughly 2-3km away, and is a distinct, separate dive site. Prior 'coral bleaching' claim likely conflated 2004 tsunami physical damage (a real, sourced phenomenon here) with bleaching (a different phenomenon, unsourced for this site) and was removed. Hawksbill-at-8-15m, chromis schools, porcupinefish, and nudibranch claims specific to this site were unsourced and removed. 2026-10-02: bay-wide species lists (turtles, moray eels, parrotfish, angelfish, butterflyfish, wrasse) stripped from markdown; still no site-specific source.
